title: The Boltzmann–Grad limit for stable radial potentials on regular kinetic intervals
main_claim: Take a stable, finite-range radial potential that is C^2 (a repulsive singularity at the origin is allowed) and C^1 initial data with spatially summable Gaussian bounds on f_0 and grad_x f_0. Then on any [0,T] where the Boltzmann equation has a classical solution with a uniform Gaussian bound, every fixed-order rescaled factorial marginal of the grand-canonical Newtonian gas with initial pair exclusion converges in L^1 to f(t)^{⊗s}, uniformly in t. Empirical-measure convergence in probability follows as a corollary.

issues.location: Sec. 6, proof of Prop. close:tails (bound on the stopped selected union), 06-closure.tex
issues.description: At the first stopped cell of layer j, the roots R of that cell are all labels already selected in the cells above it. That can be up to K_j - 1 labels, not just the U_j top roots. So Prop. cell:stopping gives |A| <= |R| D_j <= K_j D_j, not U_j D_j. The bound used afterwards is W_j = (1+U_j+K_j+D_j)^nu with nu >= 4, and that dominates K_j D_j^2 even after the positive continuation adds its factor D_j. The rest of the argument is unaffected.
issues.evidence: "Proposition~\ref{cell:stopping} therefore bounds its selected union by \max\{U_jD_j,K_j-1+D_j\}"

coverage: I read all of Sec. 0–1 and checked them line by line. Flow/stability bounds: correct. Initial insertion and centering: the occupancy identity holds, the 125-ball packing count is right and the factorial-moment bound gives (C eps)^m. Residence-time flux lemma: correct. Scattering nondegeneracy: I verified the A''(a) formula and the (pi/2)Z level-set argument. Envelope proof: I checked gamma(s) - beta - c*r >= 0 and the Volterra iteration. Sec. 2 (cell expansion and Boolean recursion, factorization, stopped product identity) I read in full; the algebra checks out. Sec. 3, all read: centering/inversion binomial identity, residual proposition, cancellation involution, and the charge bound H <= L h0 + L^2 d + L r + L i (path counting verified). Sec. 4, all read: energy ledger and Gaussian split (verified); parent Cauchy-Schwarz; crowding exponent .55r + 2(h0-k) and the .275*delta*p - 1 -> .15*delta*p step (verified). Sec. 5, all read: the tube-lemma dyadic cap computation (verified), the hook-length count, and the logic of the exposure replay construction. I did not independently re-derive every measurability claim in the replay. Sec. 6, all read: the AM-GM step giving (C b sqrt(L))^p, q^n/n! <= e^{n+h}, and the cutoff schedule induction. I checked K_k >> D_j for k < j, e^{C_L U_k P} R_k <= e^{-7 K_k}, and e^{C_L K_j P} P(B_j)^{1/2} <= e^{-3 D_j}; I found no circularity. The final passage from centered arrays to F_s and the empirical corollary are also fine. Given the paper's length (~5000 lines), the exposure-section causality and replay argument was checked for logical structure rather than every edge case.
